controls: Fresh matched controls if source, launcher, protocol or runtime changes; do not compare against historical 268/503 as the matched reference.
decisions_remaining: User chooses 503 arms after this analysis/replay. No development-accuracy tuning or rejection based only on the 64-problem panel.
native_workload: All 503 LongBench-v2 problems with matched seed-1 cells, frozen native sampler and source/runtime; retain existing 64 as development stratum.
optional_raw_interval4: raw_global_no_progress_dense_s4 as a raw frequency challenger; if chosen include stable counterpart for the same interval.
rationale: Use a 2x2 cross at interval 2 to isolate stability and progress without an interval confound, then a complete stable no-progress frequency sweep. This tests conditional effects and does not claim all factorial interactions.
selection_notes: Stable s1 explores fewer denoising calls; verify output-length mediation.
Stable s8 explores accuracy/late updates; verify N inflation against both held references.
Raw progress s2 is the near-N reference.
No-progress s2 supplies the missing matched progress comparison.
